mirrored.description: Mirrored is the number of certificates in the local mirror.

message.description: Message is a short, secret-free explanation (e.g. why storage is degraded).

CertStorageStatus.description: CertStorageStatus reports the certificate storage of an edge.

wildcard.description: Wildcard is true when the host is served by a "*.<parent>" certificate.

issuer.description: Issuer is the certificate's issuer (organization and common name), e.g. "Let's Encrypt R12".

lastError.description:
LastError is Caddy's last issuance or renewal error for the host
(kept while a newer success has not been seen).

CertificateStatus.description: CertificateStatus is what the edge knows about one routed host's certificate.

removedImages.description: RemovedImages and RemovedContainers count what was deleted.

reclaimedMb.description: ReclaimedMB is the space freed by image removals plus the BuildKit prune.

error.description: Error is a short, secret-free description of a partial failure.

CleanupResult.description: CleanupResult summarises one cleanup run (docs/04 §8): unused launchroom images beyond retention, BuildKit cache by age, leftover one-off containers.

configured.description: Configured is LR_CONTROL_PLANE_URL, the permanent fallback.

adopted.description: Adopted is the verified system.controlPlane.url requests prefer.

active.description: Active is the base URL of the last successful request.

message.description: Message is a short, secret-free reason for pending, refused or fallback.

ControlPlaneStatus.description: ControlPlaneStatus is Report.host.controlPlane: which dashboard URL this launchroomd uses (docs/03 §4.2).

chassisType.description: ChassisType is the SMBIOS chassis type (3 desktop, 10 notebook, 17 server, 23 rack mount, 35 mini PC, …).

imagesReclaimableMb.description: ImagesReclaimableMB is what images not used by any container take.

FilesystemUsage.description: FilesystemUsage is the size and free space of one filesystem.

checkedAt.description: CheckedAt is the last time the live rules were compared with the expected ones.

networks.description: Networks is the number of launchroom networks (bridges) covered.

repairs.description:
Repairs counts drift repairs since the daemon started (rules changed or
removed by something else and re-applied).

error.description: Error is a short description of the last failure.

FirewallStatus.description: FirewallStatus reports the daemon's network isolation.

cpuVendor.description: CPUVendor is /proc/cpuinfo "vendor_id" (ARM: the CPU implementer, e.g. "ARM", "Apple").

oneOf.description: DMI are the world-readable fields of /sys/class/dmi/id (no serials, no UUIDs).

deviceTreeModel.description: DeviceTreeModel is the device-tree model (single-board computers, Apple Silicon under Asahi).

virtualization.description: Virtualization is omitted when no hypervisor was detected.

osName.description: OSName is the host operating system as Docker reports it (e.g. "Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS", "Docker Desktop").

timezone.description: Timezone is the host's IANA time zone; omitted when unknown or UTC.

battery.description:
Battery is true when the machine has a system battery (a power supply
of type Battery whose scope is not Device, so a wireless mouse
doesn't count): laptops. Omitted when there is none.

hostModel.description:
HostModel is the machine model the installer read on the host where
launchroomd's VM hides it (macOS: system_profiler's "Model Name",
e.g. "Mac mini", "MacBook Pro"; LR_HOST_MODEL, D53). Display only.

HardwareFacts.description: HardwareFacts describe the machine launchroomd runs on.

message.description: Message explains a degraded or unavailable capability (secret-free).

HostCapability.description: HostCapability is one row of the capability matrix.

collectedAt.description: CollectedAt is when the snapshot was taken (daemon clock).

oneOf.description: DataDisk is the filesystem holding the daemon data dir.

DockerDisk is the filesystem holding Docker's root dir (omitted when
the daemon cannot see it, e.g. when it runs in a container without it).
Inotify are the kernel's inotify limits (/proc/sys/fs/inotify).
Networks counts Docker networks on the host.
Docker is Docker's own disk accounting (system df).
BuildCacheMB is the size of the daemon's BuildKit cache (build role only).

ClockSkewMs is the dashboard's clock minus the daemon's, from the Date
header of the last dashboard response (±1 s resolution).
Cleanup is the result of the last disk cleanup run.
Firewall is the state of the daemon's network isolation (docs/05 §1).

HostHealth.description: HostHealth is the latest host health snapshot.

at.description: At is the start of the minute (UTC, whole minute).

samples.description: Samples is the number of 15 s samples aggregated.

oneOf.description: CPUPct is busy time of all CPUs from /proc/stat, 0–100.
BuildCPUCores is the managed BuildKit container's CPU, including builds.
MemUsedMB is MemTotal − MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo.
DiskUsedMB and DiskTotalMB describe Docker's filesystem (else the data dir's).

NetRxBps and NetTxBps are bytes per second over the physical interfaces
(/proc/net/dev without lo, Docker bridges, veths and the mesh interface).
Load1 is the 1-minute load average.

HostMetricSample.description: HostMetricSample is one minute of host usage (averages over the samples of that minute).

guard.description: Guard is true when launchroomd talks to Docker through dockerd-guard.

hostOs.description:
HostOS is the operating system of the machine (darwin: a Mac, whose
Docker runs in a Linux VM; D53). Omitted by older daemons.

engine.description: Engine is the Docker distribution launchroomd runs on (D53).

buildPlatforms.description:
BuildPlatforms are the platforms this server's BuildKit can build
for: its own and the ones the engine emulates (binfmt handlers such
as Docker Desktop's QEMU or OrbStack's Rosetta; launchroom never
installs any). Omitted while buildkitd is not running (D53).

capabilities.description: Capabilities are the server's capabilities, each with its state.

HostRuntime.description: HostRuntime describes how launchroomd runs on the server: rootful or rootless Docker, whether it reaches Docker through dockerd-guard, and what the server can do as a result (docs/09 §6, docs/11 §3.2, D49).

memoryMb.description: MemoryMB is total host memory as seen by Docker (0 if unknown).

diskTotalMb.description: DiskTotalMB and DiskFreeMB describe the filesystem of the daemon data dir (0 if unknown).

dockerVersion.description: DockerVersion is the Docker Engine version; empty if Docker is unreachable.

oneOf.description:
Health is the latest periodic host health snapshot (collected every few
minutes, repeated in every report until the next one).
Mesh is the mesh client's state (docs/05 §2); omitted when the mesh is off.

Hardware describes the machine; sent when it changed or was not
acknowledged yet, and at least hourly (omitted otherwise).

Links are the latest private-network measurements to the peers of
system.linkProbe (docs/05 §2.1); omitted when there are none.

Features are the optional protocol features this launchroomd
understands (SupportedFeatures); the dashboard sends optional
NodeState fields only to servers that listed them.

ControlPlane says which dashboard URL launchroomd uses: its configured
fallback or the adopted canonical origin (docs/03 §4.2).

Runtime is how launchroomd runs here (rootless Docker, dockerd-guard)
and the resulting capability matrix (D49); omitted until known.

PublicAddresses are where the internet reaches this server: what DNS
records must point at (docs/05 §5). Omitted until known.

HostStatus.description: HostStatus describes the server at report time.

routes.description: Routes is the number of routes in the applied config.

oneOf.description: AppliedAt is when the current config was loaded into Caddy.

message.description: Message is a short, secret-free explanation when state is not applied.

oneOf.description: Certificates is the certificate state of every routed host (docs/05 §5).
Storage reports where certificates are kept (shared storage, local, degraded).

Waf is the web firewall's state at this edge (docs/03 §13.4); sent by
edges announcing the daemon feature "waf".

IngressStatus.description: IngressStatus reports whether the rendered route table is live in Caddy.

InotifyLimits.description: InotifyLimits are the kernel's per-user inotify limits.

measuredAt.description: MeasuredAt is when the latency probe ran (daemon clock).

oneOf.description:
RTTMs is the median round trip of a few small messages over one
connection, in milliseconds; omitted when the probe failed.

error.description: Error says why the latest probe failed (secret-free); omitted on success.

oneOf.description:
ThroughputMbps is the latest download rate from the peer (a short,
size-capped transfer, measured rarely); omitted until one succeeded.
ThroughputAt is when that transfer ran.

LinkMeasurement.description: LinkMeasurement is one entry of Report.host.links: the latest measurement from this server to a peer.

connection.description: Connection is direct, relay (via DERP) or idle.

relay.description: Relay is the DERP region code in use (relay) or the peer's home region.

oneOf.description: LastHandshake is the last WireGuard handshake with the peer.

MeshPeer.description: MeshPeer is one peer in the mesh status.

ipv4.description: IPv4 and IPv6 are this server's mesh addresses once connected.

message.description: Message explains starting, needs_login and error states (secret-free).

oneOf.description: Peers are the other servers this client knows (at most 256).

checkedAt.description: CheckedAt is when the client was last asked (daemon clock).

MeshStatus.description: MeshStatus is Report.host.mesh: the mesh client's view (omitted when the mesh is off).

NetworkUsage.description: NetworkUsage counts Docker networks: all of them (Docker's default address pools run out at about 30 networks) and those launchroom manages (with subnets from launchroom's own range, docs/05 §1).

PathCount.description: PathCount is one normalised path's requests in a window.

PathTotals.description: PathTotals are request counts of one path (or of the "other" bucket).

consecutiveFailures.description: ConsecutiveFailures counts failures after the start period.

lastError.description: LastError is the last probe failure (e.g. "connection refused", "HTTP 500").

ProbeStatus.description: ProbeStatus is the result of the daemon's external health probe.

PublicAddresses.description: PublicAddresses are the server's public addresses as IP echo services see them, or as LR_PUBLIC_IPS sets them.

PullProgress.description: PullProgress is an in-flight image pull: compressed layer bytes downloaded of the total (0 while the total is not known, e.g.

ReferrerCount.description: ReferrerCount is one referrer host's requests in a window.

version.description: Version of the rejected document (0 when it could not be read).

error.description: Error is the validation error (secret-free; documents carry sealed values only).

Rejection.description: Rejection describes a NodeState launchroomd refused (Report.stateRejected).

host.description: Host are per-minute host aggregates, oldest first.

workloads.description: Workloads are per-minute aggregates of the managed workload containers, oldest first.

requests.description:
Requests are per-minute traffic aggregates of the routes this edge
serves, from Caddy's access log (docs/15 §1); omitted when there are none.

analytics.description:
Analytics are per-10-minute top paths, referrer hosts and client
classes of the routes this edge serves (docs/15 §5); omitted when
there are none.

waf.description:
Waf are per-10-minute web firewall results of the routes this edge
serves (docs/03 §13.4); omitted when there are none.

route.description: Route is the NodeState route the request's host belongs to.

at.description: At is the start of the window (UTC, a multiple of 10 minutes).

requests.description: Requests is the number of requests in the window.

paths.description: Paths are the most requested normalised paths, most requested first.

otherPaths.description: OtherPaths sums every path outside Paths.

referrers.description: Referrers are the most frequent referrer hosts (other than the route's own hosts).

otherReferrers.description: OtherReferrers sums the referrer hosts outside Referrers.

browsers.description:
Browsers, Bots and OtherAgents classify the user agent coarsely
(Caddy reduces it to one token before the line leaves it).

RequestAnalyticsSample.description: RequestAnalyticsSample is one 10-minute window of one route at this edge.

route.description: Route is the NodeState route the request's host belongs to.

at.description: At is the start of the minute (UTC, whole minute).

requests.description: Requests is the number of requests (all status codes).

bytesIn.description: BytesIn are request body bytes read; BytesOut response bytes written.

latencyMs.description:
LatencyMs counts non-1xx requests per duration bucket (LatencyBoundsMs
plus overflow, 15 entries); omitted when there was no such request.

RequestMetricSample.description: RequestMetricSample is one minute of one route's traffic at this edge.

message.description: Message explains refused and failed outcomes.

VolumeDeletionResult.description: VolumeDeletionResult is the outcome of one NodeState.deleteVolumes entry.

WafCategoryCount.description: WafCategoryCount is one category's requests in a window.

WafCounts.description: WafCounts are blocked and detected requests.

path.description: Path is the normalised request path (analytics rules, docs/15 §5.1).

rules.description: Rules are the matched detection rules, 1–8.

oneOf.description:
Targets are the matched parts of the request: variable and key name
only ("ARGS:q", "REQUEST_HEADERS:User-Agent"), ≤ 8.

clientNetwork.description:
ClientNetwork is the network of the TCP peer the edge saw (a proxy's
behind a proxy), cut on the edge to /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6). The full
address never leaves launchroomd.

score.description: Score is CRS's inbound (or outbound) anomaly score.

reference.description: Reference is the transaction id shown on the 403 page.

WafEvent.description: WafEvent is one request that reached the anomaly threshold.

WafPathCount.description: WafPathCount is one normalised path's requests in a window.

WafRuleCount.description: WafRuleCount is one rule's requests in a window.

route.description: Route is the NodeState route the request's host belongs to.

at.description: At is the start of the window (UTC, a multiple of 10 minutes).

blocked.description:
Blocked requests were refused (mode block); Detected requests would
have been (mode log). Together at least 1.

categories.description:
Categories count requests per attack category; a request with rules of
several categories counts in each.

oneOf.description: Rules are the most matched detection rules (requests per rule), ≤ 20.

Paths are the most affected normalised paths, ≤ 10; with OtherPaths
they add up to Blocked and Detected.
Events are individual requests of the window, ≤ 20 (docs/22 §6.5).

WafSample.description: WafSample is one 10-minute window of one route's firewall results at this edge.

engine.description:
Engine and RuleSet name the compiled-in versions ("coraza 3.8.1",
"OWASP CRS 4.25.0"); omitted with state unsupported.

routes.description: Routes is the number of routes with the firewall in the applied config.

droppedRecords.description: DroppedRecords counts audit records launchroomd could not queue since it started.

WafStatus.description: WafStatus is the firewall's state at this edge.

checkedAt.description: CheckedAt is when the archive directory was last looked at.

oneOf.description: LastArchivedAt is when segments were last stored in the repository.

lastSegment.description: LastSegment is the newest segment stored so far (by name).

pendingSegments.description: PendingSegments are completed segments in the directory not stored yet.

message.description: Message is a short, secret-free explanation of a failing state.

WalArchiveStatus.description: WalArchiveStatus is the WAL shipping state of one workload (Report.walArchives).

at.description: At is the start of the minute (UTC, whole minute).

oneOf.description: CPUCores is the average CPU used, in cores (0.5 = half a core).
MemMB is the average memory used (Docker's usage minus inactive file cache).

WorkloadMetricSample.description: WorkloadMetricSample is one minute of one workload container's usage.

containerId.description: ContainerID is the Docker container id (64 hex) if one exists.

message.description: Message is a short, secret-free explanation (e.g. probe failure).

oneOf.description:
DetectedPorts are TCP ports the container listens on (port discovery).
Omitted when discovery is not possible.
Health is the external probe result; omitted for workloads without a probe.
Pull is the progress of the image pull while the phase is pulling.

WorkloadStatus.description: WorkloadStatus is the observed state of one workload.

full.description: Full is true for a complete snapshot (always after reconnecting), false for deltas.

appliedVersion.description: AppliedVersion is the NodeState version the daemon is converging to (0 = none yet).

oneOf.description: Host carries current host facts (resources, Docker version).
Ingress is the state of the local Caddy (edge servers; omitted when Caddy is disabled).

StateRejected is set while the newest NodeState the dashboard served was
rejected (it did not decode or validate); launchroomd keeps converging to
its last good state (appliedVersion). Omitted otherwise.
VolumeDeletions are the outcomes of the current NodeState's deleteVolumes. Omitted when none were requested.
Metrics are per-minute usage aggregates not delivered yet; omitted when there are none.

WalArchives is the WAL shipping state of every workload with a
walArchive (point-in-time recovery); omitted when there is none.

title: Report: POST /daemon/v1/reports body
description: Report is the daemon's observed state.
